parameterNotes.container: the container that segfaulted; the restart counter is per container in the source, and the corpus carries the one that looped.
parameterNotes.windowHours: the span the restarts were counted over, stated for a replay; the counter's reading is the total, and the window is what makes it a rate.
parameterNotes.signal: the signal that ended each attempt, which is why every exit precedes any probe; the probe ratio states the outcome, not the cause.

groundTruth.rootCauseReason: The container segfaults in the native ffmpeg binding about two seconds after each start takes its first job, before the HTTP listener is up, so the liveness probe never passes and the process is restarted again -- 178 times in twelve hours. The exits all predate the probe window, which is what rules the probe out as the cause.

rootCauseIndicators.description: the crash is in the native binding, two seconds after the first job, on every start
no probe ever passes, because the listener never comes up to answer one

causalChain.mechanism: each start takes a job, segfaults in the native binding about two seconds later, and the container exits before the listener is up
the pod never reaches a state where the probe can pass, so the service has no healthy replica to transcode anything

evidenceCheckpoints.description: restarts by the end of the twelve-hour window -- the text's own count, which is why the window is twelve hours rather than the corpus's usual half hour
no probe ever passes, which is the second sentence's mechanism: the process exits before the listener can answer
the native binding's fault, logged on every start within two seconds of the first job

remediation.action: pin the ffmpeg native binding to the version before the upgrade, or run it out of process so a fault cannot take the container down

sli.none: a crash loop is read as how many times the container restarted and what share of liveness probes passed, and neither is a time the harness could rank by.

query: The media-transcoder container has restarted 178 times in twelve hours. What is the root cause, and why are the liveness probes not it?
